The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of a single α1,2 mannose is sufficient to stabilise the N-linked α1,6 mannose backbone and that this is important for both cell wall structure and virulence of the fungus.
the addition of α1-2 mannose by Mnn2 and Mnn21 is essential for the formation of mannan fibrils and the maintenance of the complex cell wall architecture of C. albican.
